title: Haus · Energie & Wärmepumpen
description: Live-Werte und Verlauf von PV-Anlage (Sungrow SH20T) und Wärmepumpen (Brötje BLW NEO).

panels.title: Batterie
panels.description: Positiv = Batterie entlädt ins Haus, negativ = Batterie wird geladen.

panels.title: Netz
panels.description: Positiv = Bezug aus dem Netz, negativ = Einspeisung.

panels.title: Autarkie heute
panels.description: Anteil des heutigen Hausverbrauchs aus PV und Batterie.

targets.expr: (1 - max by (appliance) (housevitals_daily_import_energy_kWh{appliance="inverter"}) / (max by (appliance) (housevitals_daily_direct_consumption_kWh{appliance="inverter"}) + max by (appliance) (housevitals_daily_battery_discharge_kWh{appliance="inverter"}) + max by (appliance) (housevitals_daily_import_energy_kWh{appliance="inverter"}))) and on(appliance) max by (appliance) (housevitals_up) == 1

panels.title: Erreichbar
panels.description: Letzte Modbus-Abfrage erfolgreich. Keine Anzeige = Dienst liefert keine Daten.

panels.title: JAZ seit Inbetriebnahme
panels.description: Jahresarbeitszahl: gelieferte Wärme / aufgenommener Strom, gesamt.

targets.expr: (max by (appliance) (housevitals_heat_delivered_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump1"}) / max by (appliance) (housevitals_electricity_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump1"})) and on(appliance) max by (appliance) (housevitals_up) == 1

(max by (appliance) (housevitals_heat_delivered_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump2"}) / max by (appliance) (housevitals_electricity_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump2"})) and on(appliance) max by (appliance) (housevitals_up) == 1

panels.title: Leistung
panels.description: Batterie: positiv = entlädt, negativ = lädt. Netz: positiv = Bezug, negativ = Einspeisung.

panels.title: Energie pro Tag
panels.description: Tagessummen aus den Gesamtzählern. Der Balken des laufenden Tages wächst bis Mitternacht (Tagesgrenzen in UTC).

targets.expr: sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_direct_consumption_kWh_total{appliance="inverter"}[1d] offset -1d)) + sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_battery_discharge_kWh_total{appliance="inverter"}[1d] offset -1d)) + sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_import_energy_kWh_total{appliance="inverter"}[1d] offset -1d))

panels.title: Wärmepumpen · Strom pro Tag
panels.description: Stromverbrauch je Wärmepumpe und Tag (Zähler in ganzen kWh).

panels.title: Arbeitszahl pro Tag
panels.description: Wärme / Strom je Tag. An Tagen mit wenig Laufzeit ungenau (Zähler in ganzen kWh).

targets.expr: sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_heat_delivered_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump1"}[1d] offset -1d)) / sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_electricity_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump1"}[1d] offset -1d))

sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_heat_delivered_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump2"}[1d] offset -1d)) / sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_electricity_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump2"}[1d] offset -1d))
